title: cli-ux-probe trace record
description: One JSON record per shim invocation. The trace file is JSONL: one record per line.

ts.description: Unix epoch seconds with fractional precision, captured just before the real binary is exec'd.

argv.description: Full argv as seen by the shim. argv[0] is the symlink's basename (the target CLI's name).

cwd.description: Working directory of the shim process when invoked.

parent_cmd.description: Best-effort caller-shell command line via `ps -o command=` on the parent PID. When the caller is `bash -c '<line>'` / `zsh -c '<line>'` (typical for agent shell tools) this contains the AUT's pipeline + redirects. If the runner exec's the binary directly without a shell, this is less informative.

stdin.description: Bytes received on stdin, UTF-8-sanitised. Empty when stdin was a TTY or had no pending data.

stdout.description: Bytes the real binary wrote to stdout, UTF-8-sanitised. Not truncated.

stderr.description: Bytes the real binary wrote to stderr, UTF-8-sanitised. Not truncated.

exit.description: Exit status of the real binary.
